end.summary:
Practised how earthworm tunnels let air and water into soil.
Practised how soil animals turn dead leaves into rich soil.
Pihu suggested that tunnels may help plants get water (turn 2).
The belief that earthworms harm soil, eat roots, or should be removed remained at the end (turns 10–13).
Teach-back was not passed after three attempts.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the two ways soil animals help: earthworm tunnels let in air and water, and soil animals help turn dead leaves into rich soil. Pihu connected tunnels with plants getting water, but the mix-up that earthworms spoil soil or eat roots was still present at the end and was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, look at a small patch of soil or a leaf pile together and ask Pihu to explain one way an earthworm can help.
